summary: Iteration 33: Custom Domain UI + White-Label Branding Feature - All 18 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI tests confirmed all components working: Brand Identity inputs, Logo/Favicon upload, Color pickers with live preview, Custom Domain with DNS instructions, Save functionality with persistence. BrandingProvider context applies dynamic branding across app.

TestAdminBrandingEndpoints.test_get_admin_branding_with_auth: PASSED - Returns full config with custom_domain fields
TestAdminBrandingEndpoints.test_update_branding_platform_name: PASSED - Saves and returns updated name
TestAdminBrandingEndpoints.test_verify_domain_requires_domain_confi: PASSED - Returns 400 when no domain set

admin_dashboard_branding_tab.branding_tab_visible: PASSED - 'Branding & Domain' tab found and clickable

brand_colors_section.live_preview: PASSED - Live Preview shows gradient, Primary button, Outline button, Badge

custom_domain_section.dns_instructions: PASSED - DNS Configuration section appears when domain entered

save_functionality.save_toast: PASSED - 'Branding saved successfully' toast shown after save

context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding & Custom Domain feature complete. Tab located in Admin Dashboard as last tab 'Branding & Domain' (icon: Paintbrush). All data-testid attributes present: brand-name-input, brand-tagline-input, brand-footer-input, brand-support-email, brand-upload-logo-btn, brand-upload-favicon-btn, brand-primary-color, brand-accent-color, brand-domain-input, brand-domain-status, brand-verify-domain-btn, save-branding-btn. BrandingProvider.jsx applies CSS variables (--brand-primary, --brand-accent), updates favicon and page title dynamically. BrandFooter.jsx displays platform name and footer text from context. Public endpoint /api/branding/public returns branding for unauthenticated frontend use.

mocked_apis.none: All endpoints are fully functional, including DNS verification via socket.getaddrinfo

branding_endpoints.public_branding: GET /api/branding/public - No auth, returns: platform_name, tagline, logo_url, favicon_url, primary_color, accent_color, footer_text
branding_endpoints.admin_get_branding: GET /api/admin/branding - Admin auth, returns full config including custom_domain and custom_domain_status
branding_endpoints.admin_update_branding: POST /api/admin/branding - Admin auth, saves: platform_name, tagline, logo_url, favicon_url, primary_color, accent_color, custom_domain, footer_text, support_email
branding_endpoints.admin_upload_logo: POST /api/admin/branding/upload-logo - Admin auth, accepts PNG/JPG/SVG/WebP/ICO up to 5MB, returns {url, filename}
branding_endpoints.admin_verify_domain: POST /api/admin/branding/verify-domain - Admin auth, does DNS lookup, returns {domain, status, dns_result}

ui_components.BrandingProvider: /app/frontend/src/components/BrandingProvider.jsx - Context provider, fetches /api/branding/public, applies CSS vars
ui_components.BrandFooter: /app/frontend/src/components/BrandFooter.jsx - Uses branding context for dynamic footer
